position.zh: 品牌与产品设计师｜AI 辅助设计与数字体验
position.en: Brand & Product Designer | AI-assisted Design & Digital Experiences

summary.zh: 连接品牌识别、产品形态与数字体验。从问题梳理、视觉系统到模型、原型与上线协作，用 AI 加快探索，用设计判断推动方案落地。
summary.en: Connecting brand identity, product form and digital experiences. From framing problems and visual systems to models, prototypes and launch collaboration, I use AI to accelerate exploration and design judgment to move ideas into practice.

description.zh: 从用户研究、材料工艺与人机关系出发，建立产品造型、结构表达和设计验证的方法。
description.en: A foundation in user research, materials and ergonomics, extending into product form, structural communication and design evaluation.

place.zh: 湖南欧音文化传媒有限公司

description.zh: 参与市场调研、用户反馈整理和交互原型设计，协助团队把需求转化为可讨论、可迭代的体验方案。
description.en: Contributed to market research, user feedback synthesis and interaction prototypes, helping the team turn requirements into tangible proposals.

description.zh: 参与 Hermès、Arc’teryx 商业橱窗与铝型材灯具的三维设计和视觉呈现。研究空间、道具与商品的关系，以及材料在光线中的表现。
description.en: Contributed to Hermès and Arc’teryx window displays and aluminum lighting visualization, exploring spatial composition, props, merchandise, materials and light.

place.zh: 杭州理灵企业服务有限公司

description.zh: 负责彼源 AI 整体视觉设计并辅助上线；推进 Periastra 与夜礼司品牌研究、标志方案和应用表达，协调设计方向、版本与交付。
description.en: Responsible for Biyuan AI’s overall visual design and supported its launch. Advanced Periastra and Yelisi brand research, identity directions and applications, coordinating design decisions, versions and delivery.

description.zh: 通过镜序、砚台和薪跳等实际项目，探索参考分析、结构化输出、人工确认与任务恢复。让 AI 进入可检验的工作流程，并保留来源与判断。
description.en: Exploring reference analysis, structured outputs, human confirmation and task recovery through Lensflow, Yantai and Xintiao. Bringing AI into inspectable workflows with retained sources and judgment.
